proposal.observation: Ten magenta verticals are present and ring_count_error is 0, but the detected-lines image is dominated by short horizontal segments (about 50 lines near 0 degrees, length about 50 px). Oblique detections are fewer and broken: negative-slope lines cluster near -8 to -10 degrees with many stubs, positive-slope lines near +8 to +10 degrees are sparse, and the left rings show joint ink with almost no overlays. correspondence_f1@15 is 0.316 (chamfer 68.7 px) while sam_fill_rate 0.756, depth_nan_ratio 0.193, and ring_count_error 0 are not the failing features. Stage-1 residual is 1.90 cm, inside the 10 cm gate.
proposal.rule: When oblique yield is low, near-horizontal segments outnumber the +/-5 to 10 degree lines, and rings that still show joint ink have almost no overlays, while ring count and depth-NaN stay acceptable, classify this as horizontal fallback from missing oblique lines (d7), not as an unfolding, radial-gate, or fill failure.
proposal.rationale: The complex correspondence-improve example (s021) raised correspondence_f1@15 on the same family with a healthy ring count using a low oblique Hough threshold, a high horizontal threshold, and a large oblique maxLineGap; that was a joint outcome, not a per-key effect. The degrade example moved those three knobs the other way and correspondence collapsed, together with a tight radial gate that must not be copied here (depth_nan_ratio is already 0.193; that example drove it to 0.93). Unfolding is omitted because stage 1 is locked. SAM is left unchanged because fill is already 0.756 and the fill-seeking example lost correspondence. Vertical Hough is left unchanged because all 10 ring lines are already present.
